svg.text: Garden cisterns T-1/T-2/T-3 for irrigation only
Backup into RT-1 via 50 mm air gap + RPZ
2,000 L PE tank, venturi aerator, float + level
30 L resin, brine tank, meter-initiated regen
TREATMENT TRAIN (WATER TREATMENT SHED, UTILITY YARD)
Meter + RPZ, 50 mm air gap into RT-1
Demand: 6 people x 200 L + pool/plunge make-up ≈ 1.5 m³/day; peak 60 L/min
Well depth: 60-120 m (typical Thai deep well), confirm by DGR hydro-survey
Casing: 150 mm (6") PVC Class 13.5 + steel surface casing, grouted 6 m
Pump: Submersible 1.5 kW (2 HP), 3 m³/h @ 60 m head, dry-run + low-level cut-out
Storage: 2,000 L raw (aeration, contact time) + 4,000 L treated (≈ 2.5 days) + 300 L pressure tank. Cisterns T-1..T-3 stay garden-only.
WATER TEST FIRST: Lab water test (Fe, Mn, hardness, TDS, pH, nitrate, arsenic, coliform) BEFORE final treatment selection; about 3,000-5,000
THB. Iron/manganese and softening stages are installed only if the test shows they are needed.
Controls: well pump on RT-1 level; ΔP alerts call a backwash on solar surplus; UV fault closes the house valve and alerts; tank levels on
Drilling 100 m incl. casing, gravel pack, grout, development
Mains backup, RPZ, air gaps, piping, install
Act) for wells > 15 m deep; licensed
Backflow: RPZ on mains, air gaps on
Locate the well > 30 m from the drain
